integrity: The proof reduces the operator norm exactly to a one-variable Fourier multiplier minimax problem and solves both branches analytically.
Known low-order constants are recovered exactly as consistency checks.
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the natural first nontrivial support radius n=1; no larger-radius all-order formula is claimed.
The originality check found no equivalent radius-one all-order classification, but uncatalogued approximation-theory formulations cannot be excluded absolutely.
The numerical verifier checks representative orders and asymptotics; it is not used as evidence for the infinite analytic theorem.
title: All-order sharp three-point smoothest averages
